name: Arpsant
look: a slender green songbird with a white crest tipped orange, a narrow yellow eye, a white feather collar, an orange belly and a lyre of a curved twig strung with orange leaves
entry: It strings a curved twig with leaves to make a harp. Its music calms angry Pokémon, and the leaves it plays on glow faintly when it is in a good mood.
how: Evolve Whissant at level 16. It learns Confusion when it evolves.
